owner_pr.body:
The first main-branch v1.44 qualification failed its workflow-policy test and the gallery skip-link check. This corrects those checks and closes four additional release-tooling gaps found during preflight, while preserving the Strategy runtime, scientific bodies, acceptance cases, budgets and authority.

- Add the mandatory Strategy gate to the historical/package dependency contract; run the workflow-policy tests in PR smoke CI.
- Wait for the exact skip-link destination before retaining the existing fragment, focus, viewport and bilingual assertions.
- Pin Ruff to the existing locked 0.12.5 implementation. Preserve exact-type checks, including rejection of bool/subclass inputs.
- Require actual Semgrep 1.99 execution on 42 explicit Python files with two pinned local rules: direct eval/exec and literal subprocess shell=True. Missing engine, missing coverage, skipped rules, errors, findings and scanner impersonation fail. This is bounded rule coverage, not a general security proof.
- Check the committed release delta against accepted v1.43 source 5499495911bf8822ac0aa8c9007f00789c1132b5. Admit only 20 exact reviewed static scientific binary records, with path, mode, Git blob, digest, size, media and provenance checks; preserve all 239 scientific bodies. Unknown, renamed, changed or masked bodies fail.
- Apply the unchanged local proprietary/pay-walled text heuristic to committed added UTF-8 lines. Retain the positive finding for one exact Apache-2.0 synthetic regression fixture; independent content review found no private/pay-walled excerpt in it. Only that exact path/blob/hash/mode is admitted in release mode. Copies, edits, masks and overrides fail; staged behavior is unchanged. This heuristic is neither an actual model call nor a secret scan.

Validation:
- 409 focused checks pass without skips, including actual-engine adversarial tests; independent policy review repeated 71 checks.
- Binary admission: 118 checks pass, independently repeated.
- 241 immutable source/configuration checks pass; full tracked Ruff 0.12.5, Black, actionlint and hook configuration validation pass.
- Clean committed-source binary/text/security checks pass locally on tree 06bfa5ea7edbca9cc107414349aa2b0f85c44dc2. Public head 7392de2c85ae4ed2f9b1c11a61e65cefcbded6e9 has the identical tree; final-head receipts are being recorded.
- Old Ruff reproduced 29 findings; the old non-scanning Semgrep invocation and failed main run are preserved as failed or unqualified outcomes. Complete failed-main logs and archives are public in the existing evidence branch at 1f4bc79661a9b221c343689048208f55eefa54bd under docs/delivery/strategy-succession-20261025/failed-main-f836/.

This PR changes 14 quality/workflow paths. It grants no new runtime or production authority and does not retry held Harness/Fleet operations. Fresh configured code/security review and all applicable PR checks are required on this head. The normal main release and actual public-package browser/executor installation remain required after merge.

Coordinates through #4850; continues the existing Strategy owner branch and publisher.
